name: Immuflex
description: An advanced immunomodulatory therapy for individuals with augmentation loads exceeding 40% body mass replacement, where standard rejection suppressors become insufficient and the immune system requires comprehensive recalibration rather than simple suppression. Immuflex works by reprogramming regulatory T-cell populations to recognize a vastly expanded set of synthetic materials as self, while simultaneously boosting innate immunity to compensate for the adaptive suppression required. It is a sophisticated and expensive intervention that heavy augment users cannot function without.
effects: comprehensive immune recalibration for heavy-augment physiology
regulatory T-cell reprogramming for synthetic material tolerance
reduces systemic inflammation from multiple augment-tissue interfaces
side_effects: flu-like symptoms for 48–72 hours post-injection during recalibration phase
narrow therapeutic window — overdose causes autoimmune flares
extremely dangerous if administered to someone below 30% augmentation load
rare: immune system lock into tolerogenic state, reducing pathogen response to dangerous levels
cultural_context: Immuflex is the drug of the heavily augmented — full-conversion operators, corporate security with military-grade chrome, workers in industries that require extreme augmentation. The cost creates a brutal economic trap: heavy augmentation is often required for certain high-paying jobs, but maintaining that augmentation costs a significant fraction of that income. Tier 3 heavy-augment workers sometimes form medication co-ops to share monitoring costs. On the Gray Zone, former military operators with heavy chrome and no income are among the most medically precarious people in GLMZ.
story_hooks: A veteran full-conversion operative living in the Gray Zone can't afford Immuflex and is weeks away from a systemic immune collapse — she has skills that anyone willing to pay for her medication could use.

A Helix researcher has developed a one-time gene therapy that could replace monthly Immuflex injections permanently — the therapy was quietly shelved when the financial modeling showed it would destroy a major revenue stream.

Someone is selling black-market Immuflex to low-augmentation users as a performance drug with catastrophic results — the autoimmune flares are being written off as chrome rejection by overwhelmed the Gray Zone clinics.
